title: JVP Trilogy: geodesic kinematics, CBRA, and the cybernetic impossibility of conversion
description: Three interlinked papers and a pre-registered in-silico validation suite. Software: SPD/density-matrix manifold geometry (square-root, affine-invariant, log-Euclidean, Bures-Wasserstein), jump-diffusion simulation with Cartan anti-development, Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition, and geodesic change-point detectors for non-stationary multichannel signals on curved state spaces. Every experimental claim is backed by a pre-registration written before execution and a committed raw result.json (see METHODOLOGY.md).
